output_list.criticism: The 'transferProxy' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an attacker to a very large value. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by setting the balance of the attacker to a large value.

The 'approveProxy' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'allowance' of an attacker to a very large value. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by setting the allowance of the attacker to a large value.

The 'receiveApproval' function does not check the 'msg.data.length' before executing, it may cause a DoS (Denial of Service) when a attacker calls it. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a large amount of data in the 'msg.data'.
